source_categories.official_team_gallery: Official team/club gallery, recap, or photo surface.
source_categories.official_league_gallery: Official league gallery, recap, or photo surface.
source_categories.official_federation_or_tournament: Official federation, tournament, NCAA, or championship photo surface.
source_categories.verification_only_player_page: Roster, player profile, media guide, or stats page used only as an identity anchor.
source_categories.editorial_wire: Getty, AP, Reuters, Imagn, or similar editorial marketplace lead.
source_categories.reputable_newsroom_gallery: Reputable newsroom, local beat, regional broadcaster, or public media gallery.
source_categories.official_social: Official athlete, team, league, federation, or tournament social post.
source_categories.third_party_creator_public: Independent photographer, portfolio, Flickr, SmugMug, or creator-owned public lead.
source_categories.gray_area_public_lead: Fan, repost, archive, forum, or weak-provenance public lead for parking only.

rights_classes.official_review_needed: Official source found; no publish-ready rights are assumed.
rights_classes.official_partner_licensed_manual_review: Official surface using partner/licensed imagery such as Getty or similar.
rights_classes.editorial_wire_rights_sensitive: Editorial marketplace or wire source; licensing review is mandatory.
rights_classes.newsroom_photo_rights_sensitive: Newsroom or beat outlet image; rights/provenance review is mandatory.
rights_classes.social_uncleared: Social discovery lead; rights remain unclear.
rights_classes.third_party_creator_uncleared: Independent creator lead; provenance and permission remain unclear.
rights_classes.gray_area_lead_only: Weak chain of title; review-only lead, not a download candidate.
rights_classes.reject_do_not_pursue: Restricted, deceptive, missing provenance, or clearly unusable.

identity_confidence.confirmed_official: Caption/source identity and official roster/player anchor match cleanly.
identity_confidence.strong_context: Jersey, team, event, teammate/opponent context strongly align.
identity_confidence.weak: Low-confidence match due to obstructed, old, low-res, or thin evidence.

manual_review_statuses.not_reviewed: Generated/default state; no human decision yet.
manual_review_statuses.pending_more_info: Human needs more identity, event, rights, or source evidence.
manual_review_statuses.rejected: Do not pursue this lead further.
manual_review_statuses.approved_for_download: Human approved quarantine download only; not asset approval.

guardrail: URL-first, evidence-first, review-only candidate metadata; no downloads, approvals, or publish-ready claims.
